description: This file contains Perl test scripts for database schema and resultset operations, including tests for counting, retrieving, and manipulating database records, as well as connection handling and foreign key checks.

methods.name: TestDB->new
methods.description: Creates a new test database instance.

methods.name: $db->count
methods.description: Counts records in the database, optionally filtered by tables.

methods.name: $db->resultset
methods.description: Retrieves a resultset object for a specified table.

methods.name: $rs->first
methods.description: Retrieves the first record from the resultset.

methods.name: $rs->one_row
methods.description: Retrieves a single row as a Result object.

methods.name: $db->statistics
methods.description: Returns statistics about the database schema.

methods.name: Coocook::Schema->connect
methods.description: Establishes a database connection with various configurations.

methods.name: $schema->storage->dbh->ping
methods.description: Checks if the database handle is connected.

methods.name: $schema->sqlite_pragma
methods.description: Gets or sets SQLite PRAGMA settings.

methods.name: $db->fk_checks_off_do
methods.description: Runs a code block with foreign key checks disabled.

methods.name: $row->insert
methods.description: Inserts a new row into the database.

methods.name: $row->delete
methods.description: Deletes a row from the database.

methods.name: $db->resultset('ShopSection')->new_result
methods.description: Creates a new result object for ShopSection.

methods.name: $projects->next
methods.description: Advances the resultset cursor to the next record.

methods.name: $projects->assert_no_sth
methods.description: Asserts that the resultset has no active statement handle.
